triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: With one official validation holding workspace capacity, a different-story or no-story validate/done_required_validate reports the holder without entering its callback, then automatically runs after release and produces its own normal PASS evidence while command inventories and timeout budgets remain unchanged.
acceptanceBindings.note: Single user-visible acceptance claim spans capacity acquisition, ordered wait-and-run, evidence integrity, unchanged budgets, and the explicit bare npm boundary.
